title: CONNECT-UDP URI Template and Target Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, HTTP/3 package build, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9298 URI Template and target surface.
scope: This verification covers CONNECT-UDP URI Template level and form constraints, printable ASCII restriction, required target_host and target_port variables, allowed additional simple variables, default template use, invalid-template rejection, target host and port validation, IPv6 scoped-zone rejection, IPv6 literal colon percent-encoding, and expansion to request path/query.
preconditions: RFC 9297 HTTP Datagram and Capsule Protocol support is trace-clean.
expected_result: The focused RFC 9298 URI-template tests pass, the HTTP/3 package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9298 URI-template artifacts, generated triage reflects the slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9298 URI Template and target validation floor is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. Request construction, context-id framing, UDP socket lifecycle, forwarding, congestion, and ECN behavior remain future RFC 9298 slices.
